mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 58 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and we are currently under a waxing gibbous moon.

The city is currently seeking an Engineering Technician to help oversee municipal and transportation projects, and homeowners are reminded that a rain barrel rebate program is available to help manage stormwater utility credits.
We have plenty going on, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.
On Friday, August 15, Verona police officers conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a 29-year-old man for an O W I, his second offence.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so get ready to head over and enjoy a treat.
